purpose.en: Use it for things you do regularly, like your daily routine.
purpose.tr: Düzenli yaptığın şeyler için kullanılır; Türkçedeki "-r" (gelirim, içerim) gibi.

patternNote.en: Add -s only after he, she and it.
patternNote.tr: -s eki sadece he, she ve it'ten sonra gelir.

note.tr: He, she, it varsa fiile -s ekle.

purpose.en: Words like always and never say how often you do something.
purpose.tr: Always (her zaman), usually (genellikle), never (asla) gibi kelimeler bir şeyi ne sıklıkla yaptığını söyler.

patternNote.en: With am, is and are, the word goes after the verb: She is always late.
patternNote.tr: am, is, are ile bu kelime fiilden sonra gelir: She is always late.

examples.en: I always have breakfast at home.
He never watches TV at night.
They are usually tired on Mondays.

mistake.wrong: I go always to work by bus.
mistake.right: I always go to work by bus.

note.en: Put always before the main verb.

explanation.en: "My sister" is she, so the verb takes -s: drinks.
explanation.tr: "My sister" = she; bu yüzden fiile -s gelir: drinks.
